comments.content:
feeling bad for google, no frontier open weights model uses it 😂.

What I have done is trained a model specific to closed weights model and performed the inference on the open weights model. This is the normalized confusion matrix (across rows) for it. This is the main reason why throwing more money on data generation is giving folks a good score as their model is seeing more examples of open weights model to build an segregation criteria.

The dataset I have used is shown here is from the provided training dataset.

comments.content: Z.AI has marketed GLM for use inside coding tools built around Claude, with an Anthropic-compatible API. Tuning a model to behave like a drop-in replacement for Claude would push its style toward Claude’s, whether or not Claude was distilled to create its weights.

firstMessage.content: Trained a 9B classifier to tell 18 LLMs apart. Gemini only gets confused with Gemini. GPT only with GPT. GLM-5.3? Classified as Claude more often than as GLM-5.3 itself (68 vs 34 out of 150). Family resemblance is a hell of a thing.
